FIELDS.NAME: TreadWise Tire & Auto Center
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At TreadWise Tire & Auto Center, we specialize in providing high-quality tire sales and installation services for passenger vehicles and light trucks. Our operations include tire balancing, rotation, and basic automotive maintenance, such as oil changes and battery replacements. We focus on the sale and installation of new tires sourced from reputable manufacturers to ensure quality and safety for our customers. All of our technicians are certified and undergo regular safety training, enabling us to maintain a high standard of service while minimizing workplace accidents. Our facilities comply with all local, state, and federal regulations regarding environmental protection and waste disposal, and we take pride in maintaining clear separation between customer areas and service bays to enhance safety. Additionally, we implement seasonal promotional campaigns to effectively manage workflow and customer demand.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On January 10, 2023, we experienced water damage in our storage area due to a burst pipe, resulting in a loss amount of $2,500. The damage has been fully repaired and the area is now compliant with all safety standards. On February 5, 2023, we incurred a theft loss of $2,500 when tools were stolen from our service bay. The incident has been reported to the police, and we are currently evaluating security measures to prevent future occurrences.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Saturday: 8:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing around the facility, with 24/7 surveillance monitoring for added theft and vandalism protection.
